value.rationale: The common marked-Poisson clock answers a joint-observable question not determined by known marginal transforms; its off-diagonal covariance one produces a nonzero correlation 1/sqrt2 and joint uncertainty quantification. The error bound O_P(loglog(np)) is much smaller than the CLT scale sqrt(log(np)) uniformly even in the sparse-reset triangular regime.
